comments.body: Keep going. My hubby used to consider a 4.25 a success, since the exams were sososo difficult (informatics at ETH). This was many moons ago. The diploma has lead to a successful career in IT. 4 semesters is too far into it to waste them by dropoing out. Also, do remember that ETH is using their exams as a de facto numerus clausus since for the majority of studies, everyone can start studying. All the best!
comments.author: CHKiri
